reason: The raw audit is ALIVE_META_AUDIT_ATOMIC_v3 with flat per-record readingEvidence and no boundAtomicCrossConcepts/statistics. The registrar's supported key-only v3 adapter requires those derived fields and a paired CANDIDATE_CLASSIFICATION_PACKAGE_v2. Added fields are derived only from the raw audit records, source level, and canonical owner-pack scope; no audited value, excerpt, or student-visible field is changed.
derivedFields: statistics from raw record counts and unique templates/concepts
boundAtomicCrossConcepts from the union of audited crossConceptKeys
per-record auditStatus=APPROVED and targetPack from canonical unit ownership
per-record level from the production source
per-record auditRemarks from the audit's own difficultyReason (the raw audit has no auditRemarks field)
classification sourceFileName, contentSnippet from the audit readingEvidence, hasImage from audit visualType, level/targetPack
manifest recordsToBind standardUnitKey/subUnitKey/targetPack from the audit
